Chocolate Strawberry Banana Bread 🍓🍌✨ Ingredients: 	•	3 overripe bananas, mashed (330 g) 	•	4 tbsp unsalted butter, melted (56 g) 	•	¼ cup Greek yogurt or sour cream (60 g) 	•	½ cup brown sugar, packed (100 g) 	•	¼ cup granulated sugar (50 g) 	•	1 large egg (≈50 g) 	•	1 tsp vanilla extract (5 g) 	•	1¼ cups all-purpose flour (150 g) 	•	⅓ cup cocoa powder (≈30 g) 	•	1 tsp baking soda (5 g) 	•	1 tsp cinnamon (≈2.5 g) 	•	Dash of salt (≈0.5 g) 	•	½ cup chocolate chips, plus more for topping (85 g) 	•	⅓ cup chopped strawberries (≈50 g), plus extra for topping @Nestle Toll House  Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease or line a loaf pan with parchment paper.In a medium bowl, mash the bananas until smooth. Add the melted butter and Greek yogurt (or sour cream) and mix until combined. Stir in the egg and vanilla extract. Add the brown sugar and granulated sugar; mix well until smooth. Gently fold in the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt until just combined — do not overmix. Fold in the chocolate chips and chopped strawberries. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan. Sprinkle extra chocolate chips and chopped strawberries on top. Bake for 35–40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out mostly clean (a few moist crumbs are okay). Let cool in the pan for 10–15 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. #bananabread #Recipe #chocolatestrawberries #valentine #bakingrecipe

HOW TO MAKE SALT BREAD 🥐 i wanted to answer some of the questions i was getting about my salt bread recipe so i wanted to make a longer more in depth tutorial recipe link: https://erinscozykitchen.com/recipe/salt-bread-shiopan/ or look up "erinscozykitchen salt bread" on google and it should be the first link that pops up! - can i replace milk powder with milk: yes you can just replace some or all the water with milk but it will change the crumb and texture and browning, if u can i would recommend using milk powder - why cold water: when you knead your dough it will rise the temp and you want it to end up at around 78 fahrenheit when u go to do the first rise. high dough temp will affect the taste and gluten development of the dough - why is my dough sticky: your dough has either gotten too high in temp that the gluten is breaking down or you haven't kneaded it long enough and it's just underdeveloped (DONT add more flour to your dough just bc it's sticky while you're kneading it shouldn't need any flour if you kneaded it long enough). i have made these hundreds of times and i promise if you knead it long enough even if it takes a while it will come together eventually and get less sticky! if you have tried all these steps and the dough is still too difficult to work with you can try changing the unsalted butter amount to 30g instead of 40g. My current recipe is on the higher side of fat content which is why it takes a longer time to knead and for the dough to come together. if you use 30g it should come together faster and be easier to manage but will still taste good!  - how long do you knead: this depends on your mixer and speed, with my ooni halo pro it took me about 14 min total but with a kitchen aid it could take longer and by hand even longer  - where is my salt bread pan from: i got it in korea at bangsan market! it's a neighborhood that sells a lot of wholesale baking and packaging supplies. i couldn't find anything similar in the states but tbh i don't think it really makes that big of a difference! tips: • make sure you fridge your butter after you cut it, you want to roll it up with hard/cold sticks of butter • for cute fat salt bread make the top width of your rolled out inverted triangle short • start preheating your oven around 25 min after your final shaping while they're rising so they're not overproofed by the time your oven is ready • make sure to use a nonstick coated baking pan for your rolls! a plain aluminum pan will cause your rolls to stick it needs to be non stick coated :)  STORAGE • salt bread tastes best fresh out of the oven! if you don't finish them freeze them in a ziploc and to reheat, air fry at 350 f for 5-8 min #saltbread #shiopan #소금빵

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

These cabbage dumplings make that part a whole lot easier. 🥟🥟🔥 Cabbage Dumplings Ingredients Ground chicken, 2 pounds Portabella mushrooms, finely diced, 8 ounces Scallions, finely sliced, 4 Soy sauce, 2 tablespoons Oyster sauce, 1 tablespoon Chicken bouillon powder, 1 teaspoon Salt and black pepper, to taste Small Napa cabbage, 1 to 2 heads Furikake, for garnish Chili oil, for serving Sliced scallions, for garnish Instructions Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Blanch the Napa cabbage leaves for 45 seconds to 1 minute, just until softened and flexible. Transfer to a towel and pat dry. In a large bowl, combine the ground chicken, mushrooms, scallions, soy sauce, oyster sauce, chicken bouillon, salt, and pepper. Mix until everything is well combined. Spoon the filling onto the base of each cabbage leaf. Fold in the sides and roll tightly to seal. Arrange the dumplings seam side down in a large skillet or steamer. Add 1/4 cup water to the pan, cover, and steam over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees. Remove the lid and let any remaining water evaporate for 1 to 2 minutes. Finish with furikake, a drizzle of chili oil, and sliced scallions before serving. #dumplings #cabbage #healthyeating #food #foodtiktok

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Recipe Name French Onion Meatloaf with Melted Mozzarella Ingredients 1. 2 lbs (900 g) ground beef 2. 1 cup breadcrumbs 3. 2 large eggs 4. 1 small onion, finely diced 5. 2 large onions, thinly sliced 6. 3 garlic cloves, minced 7. 1/3 cup milk 8. 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 9. 2 tbsp ketchup 10. 1 tsp Dijon mustard 11. 1 tsp salt 12. 1 tsp black pepper 13. 1 tsp garlic powder 14. 1 tsp dried thyme 15. 2 tbsp butter 16. 1 tbsp olive oil 17. 1 cup beef broth 18. 1 tbsp all-purpose flour 19. 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese 20. 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Bake for 35-40 minutes on 350 degrees or until a toothpick comes out clean. Allow to cool on the counter for 30 minutes before removing from pan & placing your 2 cakes in the fridge. BLUEBERRY COMPOTE: 1 cup washed blueberries  4 tbsp water  2 tbsp white sugar  1 tbsp lemon juice  Cornstarch slurry to thicken the sauce  Mix on medium heat until it begins to thicken and then place in a bowl and set in the fridge.  CHEESECAKE: 3 SOFTENED 8oz blocks @Philly Cream Cheese cream cheese  1/2 cup white sugar 1 tbsp lemon juice & zest of 1 lemon   1 tbsp vanilla extract or bean paste  1/3 cup heavy cream  1/3 cup sour cream  5 eggs total (added 3 first, then the remaining 2)  Blend until smooth and all lumps are gone and then add half of your batter to a sprayed pan. Add half of your blueberry compote in dollops and then use a knife to swirl. Add your remaining cheesecake batter on top and then the remaining blueberry compote and swirl again. Bake for 1 hour on 350 degrees. Allow to cool on the counter for about 30 minutes, remove from the pan & then place into the freezer to set for 3-4 hours.  VANILLA BUTTERCREAM- 2 200g blocks softened unsalted butter 1 tsp vanilla extract or bean paste   4 cups powdered sugar  Blend until smooth and stiff peaks form then set aside. Cut the tops off of both of your cakes to level them & then to a cake board, add a little frosting to the bottom and then add your first cake on top, layer more frosting in between and then add your cheesecake to the middle. Add another layer of frosting and then top with your 2nd cake. Frost your entire cake and then add swirls to the top along with fresh blueberries to the middle. I also added lemon slices for garnish, along with chopped white chocolate & lemon zest. ENJOY! #baking #cheesecake #fyp #blueberry #lemon

Ingredients: 1 (25-ounce) package frozen cheese ravioli 3 1/2 cups store-bought Alfredo sauce 1 pound Italian sausage, cooked and crumbled 3 cups baby spinach 1/2 cup chopped marinated sundried tomatoes 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese, divided 1/2 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese, divided Directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (180 degrees C). Lightly grease a 3 quart baking dish with cooking spray. Spread about 1/2 cup sauce on the bottom of the dish and arrange half of the ravioli in a single layer over the sauce. Top with cooked sausage, spinach, and sundried tomatoes. Pour 1 1/2 cups of alfredo sauce over the spinach mixture. Sprinkle with half of the mozzarella and Parmesan cheese and top with the remaining ravioli in a single layer. Pour over remaining sauce and top with remaining mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses. Cover and bake for about 1 hour, uncovering during the last 15 minutes, until golden brown around the edges and bubbly. Classic Patty Melt 🥪🥩🧀 Juicy smashed beef patties sandwiched between golden, buttery toasted rye or sourdough bread with caramelized onions and gooey melted Swiss cheese! If you're looking for the ultimate classic comfort meal, you have to try this. Ingredients: Ground beef patties, sliced Swiss or Provolone cheese, rye or sourdough bread slices, caramelized onions, butter, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. To Make: Sauté sliced onions in butter over medium-low heat until soft, sweet, and deeply caramelized. Form ground beef into thin patties, season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper, and sear in a hot skillet until browned and juicy. Butter the outside of bread slices, then assemble each sandwich with a slice of cheese, a cooked beef patty, caramelized onions, another slice of cheese, and the top piece of bread. Toast on the skillet over medium heat, pressing down gently, until the bread is golden-crisp and the cheese is melted and stringy! Serve warm. 🥪🥩🔥 #usafoodie #highprotein #ketodiet #lowcarbdiet
